lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Congratulations on the account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks. It was a group effort.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm sure it was. Though your name is the only one on the brief.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I just finalized the formatting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course. Well, enjoy the promotion.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I noticed the sound again last night.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm sorry, I've been trying to keep it down.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's fine, but the contract is pretty clear about the 10 PM rule.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I understand. I'll stop using the blender.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. Let me know if the sink is still dripping.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It looks nice in here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks, I changed the rugs.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You always said you were going to do that.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I had more free time recently.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. Well, here are the rest of the boxes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So, what's your typical Sunday like?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Honestly? Mostly laundry and staring at my phone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was hoping you'd say hiking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can hike! I love hiking. I own boots.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe next week, then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you eating enough?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You sounded tired on the phone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's just work. I'm taking care of myself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, I'll let you go. Don't forget to call your sister.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I still have it, you know.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have what?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The mix CD you burned me sophomore year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh god, please burn it for real.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Never. Track 4 is legendary.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you look at the slides yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, it's brutal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we can just skip to the end.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He's going to notice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We'll just say we're prioritizing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I appreciate you looking at this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's what I'm here for.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you think I'm on the right track?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your thesis is strong, but the third paragraph needs better citations.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll revise it before Friday's deadline.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, sorry to bother you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No worries, what's up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you happen to get a package for me?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, yeah, they left it on our side of the porch yesterday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks, they always mix up the house numbers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you telling them, or should I?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You do it, you're the favorite.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I am not the favorite.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You literally didn't get grounded when you crashed the car.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was ten years ago!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did you feel when that happened?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Angry, I guess.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just angry?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe a little betrayed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let's explore that feeling of betrayal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you pay the electric bill?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, I sent you my half yesterday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You didn't do the dishes though.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's your week for the dishes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right, my bad.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do you want for dinner?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I don't know, whatever we had on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We had tacos on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tacos are fine. Are we still going to your mom's this weekend?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, unfortunately.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long have you had the cough?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: About three weeks now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Any fever or chills?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only at night.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm going to prescribe you an antibiotic.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can't believe you wore that to the party.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It was a theme party!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The theme was 'cocktail attire.'

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought it said 'cockatoo attire.'

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're an idiot, but I love you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I noticed you were late again this morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Traffic was unusually bad on the 405.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understand, but this is the third time this month.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll make sure to leave earlier tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Please do. The client presentation starts promptly at 9.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't expect to see you here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I still come here on Tuesdays. Habit, I guess.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's been a while. You look good.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks. Did you end up keeping the dog?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yeah, Buster is still with me. He misses you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you want to share the appetizer?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure, if you don't mind that I don't eat seafood.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, I didn't know that. Good to know.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, sorry. I probably should have mentioned it before we got here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No worries at all! Let's just get the spinach dip. I'm having a great time so far.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you going to be around this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly. I might go out Saturday night.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. I'm having a few people over on Friday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's fine. Just keep it in the living room, I have to work early Saturday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will do. And I'll leave your shelf in the fridge alone this time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you remember to turn it off?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I did.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because last time we left it on, it was a disaster.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know, I know. Relax, I locked the front door and checked the stove.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, good. Now put on your seatbelt, your mom hates it when we're late.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You still drink it black?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah. Some things don't change.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I guess not. It's weird sitting across from you again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I wasn't sure if I should reach out, honestly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm glad you did. It's nice to clear the air after the breakup.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You have to tell them.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why me? You're the one who noticed it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because they'll get less mad if it comes from you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is such a myth. They yell at me just as much.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Whatever. If Dad finds out we broke his golf club, we're both dead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you seen my cat around?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I haven't. When did she get out?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sometime this morning. I accidentally left the door propped open.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll keep an eye out. I'm usually working in the front yard anyway.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks so much. I really hope she didn't jump over the fence into your yard.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I really think you should consider moving closer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We've talked about this. I like where I am.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's just so far, and the drive is exhausting for me.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll visit more often, I promise.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You always say that. I just want to see my grandchildren more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you finish the paperwork yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm halfway through. The system is so slow today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tell me about it. If we don't finish by five, we're stuck here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you want to split the last batch?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sure, send half the files over to my desk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You missed the deadline again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know, I had a family emergency.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understand, but this is a pattern.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is there any way I can make it up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can offer you half credit if you turn the essay in by tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you like the red one better?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Honestly, I think the blue one suits you more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You think so? The lighting in here is terrible.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, but the blue brings out your eyes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks for the input. I'll buy this one, even though I've never met you before.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So, how have you been feeling since our last meeting?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little better, but still pretty drained.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you been keeping up with the routine we discussed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mostly. I skip some days when I'm too tired.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, the blood tests show your iron is still low, so keep taking the supplements.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm not going to approve this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why not? I spent all weekend on it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It doesn't align with what we discussed on Friday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But the creative direction is much stronger this way.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm the creative director, and I need you to stick to the client's brief.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I really thought this time would be different.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's completely normal to feel frustrated right now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But I'm just making the exact same mistakes again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Progress isn't linear. Remember what we talked about last week?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yeah, to stop being so hard on myself. It's just hard to practice that outside of your office.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You kept the sweater.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's warm. And it fits.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It used to be mine, you know.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. But you said I could have it when you moved out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did. I just didn't expect you to wear it on our first coffee since the split.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I saw your name on the list.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm sure you did. Surprised?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A little. I didn't think you'd go for it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I have just as much of a shot as you do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We'll see. The regional manager usually prefers seniority.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are we out again?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I think so. I checked this morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I literally bought a whole pack on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Well, Sarah's boyfriend was over, and he uses a lot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, from now on we each buy our own toilet paper. This is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have a confession to make.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh no. What is it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I actually hate horror movies.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wait, really? But you suggested we watch one!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know, I just wanted an excuse to sit closer to you on the couch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're doing it wrong.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm doing it exactly how they said to do it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, you're rushing it. It needs to simmer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Since when did you become a master chef?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Since Mom gave me the family recipe instead of you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can't believe we're still doing this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sitting at the exact same table, complaining about the exact same things.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hey, some things never change.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's been ten years since high school graduation. We need new hobbies.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I really don't think it's fair that you get to keep the espresso machine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I put in more than half the money when we bought it!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only because you insisted on getting the commercial grade one that took up half the counter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fine, you can have the air fryer and the microwave to balance out the split.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Deal. Once the landlord hands back our security deposit, we can both pack our own boxes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why were you looking through my history?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I wasn't snooping, your screen was literally wide open when I sat down.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Still, you didn't need to read all the recent inquiries.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When I see that you're bookmarking apartments in another state, it kind of affects my future too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm sorry, babe. I got a job offer in Chicago, and I was trying to figure out how to bring it up before our five-year anniversary trip.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did anyone follow you here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, why would anyone follow me? You're being dramatic.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I just don't want anyone else knowing about this arrangement.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's just an envelope of cash. I told you I'd pay you back every cent with interest.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sweetheart, I'm your mother. You don't need to pay me interest on your dental bill.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You stole my entire pitch.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It wasn't your pitch. It was an open brainstorming session.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I showed you my slide deck in confidence yesterday afternoon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: If the VP liked my delivery better, that's just business.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You do this every quarter. Just wait until our department performance reviews.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So... how did you think that went?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Honestly? A little more tense than I expected.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought there was some real chemistry at first, until the topic of money came up.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Talking about finances on a first date is usually a red flag.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only asked because you forgot your wallet when the check arrived.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long has it looked like that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: About four or five days. It started getting sensitive over the weekend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does it sting when I apply pressure right here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little bit, yeah. Especially when it touches cold water.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It looks like an inflamed cavity; let me numb the gum before we drill.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You seem unusually distant today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I've just had a lot weighing on my mind all week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When you withdraw like this, it makes it very difficult for us to make progress.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know, but every time I start talking about my childhood, I feel overwhelmed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's why we take it slow. Let's pause and try a grounding exercise for the rest of our session.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We really need to talk about what happened on your side of the line.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It wasn't intentional. The wind knocked everything over.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Still, your branches are dropping debris all over my freshly paved driveway.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I offered to bring my hedge trimmers over and clean it up this afternoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. As long as our property line stays clear, we won't have to bring the HOA into this.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I got your letter about the increase.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I understand it's not ideal, but maintenance costs have gone up across the board.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: An extra eight percent seems steep when the radiator still barely works.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: If you agree to sign a twelve-month extension today, I'll send the plumber over tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Make it a five percent bump and fix the leak under unit 4B, and I'll sign the lease renewal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I almost didn't recognize you in that.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. The whole point was to look completely unrecognizable.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You always took this way more seriously than I did growing up.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Someone had to win the neighborhood costume contest every October.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only because Dad helped you sew your cape while making fun of mine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you eat what was in the brown paper bag?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I didn't think anyone was claiming it since there was no sticky note.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was literally sitting on the middle shelf behind the oat milk!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I worked straight through lunch to finish the slide deck for the 2 PM meeting, I was starving.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fine, but you owe me Thai takeout, and don't touch anything in the break room fridge again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, go right ahead. Just watch out for my bag on the floor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks. Rough morning with all the delays, huh?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Terrible. I think the signal failure backed up the entire blue line.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, at least this train is finally moving. Which stop are you getting off at?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Look at you! You barely look any different.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't lie, my hairline is receding and I'm wearing reading glasses now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, compared to the photo on your profile, you haven't aged a day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I still can't believe it's been fifteen years since freshman orientation.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right? It feels like yesterday we were pulling all-nighters in dorm room 302.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was hoping we could talk about the evaluation I received.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I left detailed feedback on the margin of the third page.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I saw that, but I feel like my thesis argument was misunderstood.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your argument was creative, but you failed to cite the required primary sources from syllabus week four.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If I submit a revised draft by your office hours on Thursday, would you reconsider the B-minus?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see you're still using that terrible restaurant app.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It has all my loyalty points. Why change what works?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because half the places on there closed two years ago.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Well, you don't have to look at it anymore, do you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: True. I guess since the divorce was finalized, your dining choices aren't my problem.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you get a chance to look over the numbers I sent?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I did, and to be honest, I expected a lot more depth.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I worked with the data we had available on short notice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When leadership asks for projections, 'short notice' isn't an acceptable excuse.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Understood. I'll revise the executive summary before your morning board meeting.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You really didn't have to go through all this trouble.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It wasn't trouble at all. I actually love cooking when there's company.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Well, everything smells incredible. Can I help set the table?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just grab the wine glasses from the top cabinet. I hope cabernet is okay?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's perfect. This is definitely the best second date I've been on in years.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you noticed any stiffness when getting up in the morning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little in the lower back, but nothing unmanageable.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. And what about that numbness down the left side?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It completely went away after I finished that round of medication.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excellent. We'll skip the MRI for now and keep you on physical therapy twice a week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What time are you setting your alarm for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Probably 6:15. Why, does the vibration wake you up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, it's just that the water pressure drops to zero if we both try to shower at the same time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Got it. I'll take the 6:30 slot if you want the first twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Deal. Also, it's your turn to Venmo me for our half of the Wi-Fi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you seriously wearing that to Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What's wrong with it? It's clean.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You know how she gets if we don't look presentable.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She's going to criticize my life choices regardless of my shirt.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: True, but why give Mom free ammunition before she even carves the turkey?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I noticed your submission was missing the bibliography section.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I tried uploading it right before the midnight deadline, but the portal froze.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The system log shows your file was uploaded at 12:47 AM.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is there any way I can avoid the late penalty? My overall average really needs this.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll deduct five points instead of ten, but make sure your final exam prep starts early.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you hear what happened in the all-hands?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I had my camera off while prepping those client decks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They're restructuring the whole fourth floor starting in January.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great, that means we're probably losing our window desks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yep. Let's grab coffee in the break room before our team sync and complain together.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Were you in the hallway around noon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I was conducting the annual smoke detector inspection.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're supposed to give at least 24 hours written notice before coming on the premises.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I posted a flyer on the lobby bulletin board last Friday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A lobby flyer doesn't count as direct notice under our residential lease agreement.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, do you know how much longer the line usually takes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Once they open the second security lane, it moves pretty fast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good, my boarding group starts in twenty minutes and I'm cutting it close.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where are you flying out to?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just heading home to Denver. Have a safe flight wherever you're headed!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You didn't eat nearly enough of the stuffing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I had two full plates! I'm genuinely stuffed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You've lost weight. Are you eating properly out there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I cook every single day, I promise I'm taking care of myself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know you're thirty now, but you'll always be my baby boy. Take some leftovers home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I heard your pitch didn't make the final round.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Neither did yours, so I wouldn't celebrate just yet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At least the panel asked me follow-up questions about market strategy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They were just being polite before choosing external consultants.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Don't worry, you'll have another chance to lose the regional account to me next year.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did a delivery driver drop off a package near your steps earlier?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, there was a heavy box sitting by my porch when I got home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The shipping app said it was delivered to number 42 instead of 44.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I dragged it over near your garage so it wouldn't get rained on.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks so much. Borrowing your snowblower last week really saved our driveway, too!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did it feel when you finally said no to them?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Honestly, I felt sick to my stomach for the rest of the day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a very common somatic reaction when you first practice setting boundaries.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I kept thinking I was being selfish for putting my own needs first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Self-preservation isn't selfishness. Let's unpack that guilt before our fifty minutes are up.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who's handling the introduction during the presentation?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought Liam was doing it, but he hasn't answered the group chat all day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Typical. He barely contributed anything to the shared Google doc either.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: If he doesn't show up to lecture tomorrow, we should take his name off the title slide.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Agreed. I'm not letting a slacker ruin our group project grade for Sociology 101.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are we really doing this right now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We've been putting off this decision for six months.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's just a huge financial commitment to lock ourselves into.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We have the joint savings for it, and the interest rate is locked until Friday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're right. After seven years of renting together, let's go put down the earnest money.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can't believe how much has changed since we last sat here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. Different cities, different jobs, totally different lives.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you ever miss how simple everything used to be back then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes, but mostly I'm just glad we can pick right back up like no time passed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Same here. Twenty years since middle school band camp, and you're still my favorite person to reminisce with.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How nervous are you on a scale of one to ten?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Probably an eleven. What if they don't like me?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They're going to love you. Just be yourself and don't bring up politics.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do I shake hands, or is your crowd more of a hugging group?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just hugs! Relax, it's just drinks with my close circle so they can finally meet the person I've been gushing about for three weeks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you have a few minutes to talk about my compensation?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure, close the door. What's on your mind?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've consistently exceeded all my quarterly targets and taken on three additional accounts.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your dedication has definitely been noticed across the leadership team.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. Given my performance this year, I'd like to formally request a promotion to Senior Account Lead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why did you dig this old thing out of the attic?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because it's a classic and it still works perfectly!

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You literally broke the left controller twenty years ago and blamed it on the dog.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I was seven years old! Are you ever going to let that go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Never. You're my younger brother—holding childhood grudges is my birthright.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't think Maya invited both of us.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She did. I told her it wouldn't be awkward as long as we were civil.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are we being civil right now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm trying, but seeing you with someone else is harder than I thought.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's been a year since we broke up. We both promised we'd move on.
